_what: The director's rulings on AIMS-IA generated items. `rounds` records what was READ; `rejections` records every item refused, by item_id, with its reason and ruling.

rounds.note: AIMS-IA's FIRST round, and the cleanest first round of any certification: 88 survivors of 136 generated at $0.2227 each, and only 2 of 88 rejected on quality (2%). All 3 judge flags upheld; 1 missed (ec6ba56a/61fabc8a), a CROSS-ANCHOR pair the neighbour arm could not see because the bank held no live items to draw neighbours from.

rejections.why: RULED reject (PROMPT-137 s1): the options are phrased as "Whether..." clauses that do not answer the stem's question, and two are strawmen ("favour the auditors who raised the most findings")
RULED reject (PROMPT-137 s1): two distractors are not sources anyone would consider for measurement reliability ("office layout", "register of licences and permits")
